title: Injuro Web App & Marketing Platform
description: An AI-powered legaltech platform designed to automate personal injury client intake and attorney workflows. Contributed as part of a small engineering team to the development of the public marketing platform and the authenticated web application featuring real-time AI voice intake agents.
highlights: Contributed to the development and architecture of both marketing and authenticated web apps using Next.js (App Router) and TypeScript
Implemented full-stack authentication and role-based access control with Clerk Auth and Next.js middleware
Built custom Next.js API routes for server-side authorization checks and secure API key proxying
Integrated interactive Vapi AI and ElevenLabs voice widgets for real-time legal intake workflows
Managed asynchronous voice agent state and data fetching using TanStack Query, with Zod for API boundary validation
Delivered high-converting, accessible marketing landing pages optimized for performance and SEO

title: Quadrant Health Web App & Marketing Platform
description: An enterprise AI healthcare platform designed for patient management, clinical analytics, interactive voice/video automation, and secure healthcare messaging. As the founding frontend engineer, I built the primary web app from scratch and launched the public marketing platform, and collaborated on backend feature delivery. The platform grew from a prototype into a product handling 2M+ patient interactions annually, with 70%+ of calls resolved without staff involvement (company-reported), serving clients in the US and Europe.
highlights: Architected the core web app from scratch, establishing state management, routing, and scalable UI architecture
Implemented RBAC and feature-gating for role-based route and module access across clinical teams
Integrated real-time patient messaging, Twilio Telehealth calling, and interactive AI assistant interfaces (Vapi AI, ElevenLabs, HeyGen, Tavus)
Built dynamic appointment calendars, clinical analytics dashboards, and PDF/e-signature tools
Built live doctor-patient speech translation with Soniox and multi-language support (i18n plus LLM translation for dynamic content)
Supported PHP backend API endpoints to accelerate feature delivery and configured Docker for containerized local workflows
Configured automated quality pipelines with Playwright, Cypress, Jest, Storybook, and Bugsnag

title: Treasury Wine Estates Brand Platforms
description: A suite of high-performance web applications and brand landing pages built for major Australian wine brands. Developed in collaboration with digital agency Hide & Seek. The project focused on building a scalable, white-label frontend architecture using reusable UI component libraries, client-side headless CMS integration, smooth GSAP animations, and optimized Core Web Vitals.
highlights: Converted Figma designs into highly responsive web interfaces for multiple wine brand platforms
Developed and maintained a shared Storybook component library for rapid UI reuse across brand sites, backed by React Testing Library component tests
Integrated Storyblok headless CMS on the client side to enable non-technical teams to manage dynamic content and page layouts seamlessly
Crafted smooth, scroll-driven GSAP animations and interactive hero transitions
Optimized frontend performance, asset loading, and cross-browser compatibility

title: Map-Based Real Estate Marketplace
description: A map-based real estate marketplace connecting renters with landlords and homebuyers with sellers, with interactive map views and multi-criteria apartment search across mobile and desktop.
highlights: Built a responsive React web application with reusable layout templates, optimized for mobile and desktop in portrait and landscape orientations
Built interactive map views with property markers using the Google Maps API
Developed multi-criteria apartment search with combinable filters for price, location, property type, and amenities
Implemented light and dark themes
Created a shared component library used across company products
Wrote JUnit tests for the Java backend, refactored legacy code, and fixed bugs
